title: exu.HT where a 4x4 numpy HT is taken: rigidBodyUtilities and the robotics classes
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026b step RG16.4.2: exu.HT converts to a 4x4 numpy array (__array__), the HT functions of rigidBodyUtilities and the robotics classes (RobotLink, RobotTool, RobotBase, InverseKinematicsNumerical) take an exu.HT as well; CreateKinematicTree gives jointHTs.
releaseNotes: numpy reads an exu.HT as its 4x4 matrix (np.array(H)); the HT functions of rigidBodyUtilities and the robotics classes take an exu.HT where they take a 4x4 array.
